    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.TwoTerm.eulerWeight_eq_perpendicular_difference (k : Type u) [Field k] {R : Type u} [Ring R] [Algebra k R] [Module.Finite k R] [IsNoetherianRing R] (P : TwoTerm R) (M : FGModuleCat R) :
    (eulerWeight k P).eval M = ↑(homFinrank k (CategoryTheory.Limits.cokernel P.differential) M) - ↑(homFinrank k M (nakayamaKernel k P))

    The Euler weight measures the difference of the two perpendicular Hom dimensions.

    source
    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.TwoTerm.nonneg_eulerWeight_all_quotients_iff (k : Type u) [Field k] {R : Type u} [Ring R] [Algebra k R] [Module.Finite k R] [IsNoetherianRing R] (P : TwoTerm R) (hP : P.IsPresilting) (M : FGModuleCat R) :
    (∀ {Q : FGModuleCat R} (q : M ⟶ Q) [CategoryTheory.Epi q], 0 ≤ (eulerWeight k P).eval Q) ↔ Subsingleton (M ⟶ nakayamaKernel k P)

    The weak quotient test is the left perpendicular of the Nakayama kernel.

    source
    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.TwoTerm.nonpos_eulerWeight_all_subobjects_iff (k : Type u) [Field k] {R : Type u} [Ring R] [Algebra k R] [Module.Finite k R] [IsNoetherianRing R] (P : TwoTerm R) (hP : P.IsPresilting) (M : FGModuleCat R) :
    (∀ {L : FGModuleCat R} (i : L ⟶ M) [CategoryTheory.Mono i], (eulerWeight k P).eval L ≤ 0) ↔ Subsingleton (CategoryTheory.Limits.cokernel P.differential ⟶ M)

    The weak subobject test is the right perpendicular of the cokernel.

    source
    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.TwoTerm.isSemistable_eulerWeight_iff_perpendicular (k : Type u) [Field k] {R : Type u} [Ring R] [Algebra k R] [Module.Finite k R] [IsNoetherianRing R] (P : TwoTerm R) (hP : P.IsPresilting) (M : FGModuleCat R) :
    (eulerWeight k P).IsSemistable M ↔ Subsingleton (CategoryTheory.Limits.cokernel P.differential ⟶ M) ∧ Subsingleton (M ⟶ nakayamaKernel k P)

    The semistable modules at the weight of a presilting differential are exactly the modules in its two Hom perpendiculars.
